analyst_view.overall: Early view: fourth-placed Eibar (23 pts from 12) host seventh-placed Sporting (22 pts from 13) in a play-off-race game. Eibar's league game at Castellón and their Copa del Rey tie in Pamplona were both postponed, so they may face a crowded December. Sporting under Nicolás Larcamón have had a long injury list (seven out in early November) and Juan Otero's red-card ban should be served long before this match.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.3 goals. Eibar score well at Ipurua (21 in 12) while Sporting have scored only 14 all season, so a moderate total fits and I stay with the number.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.6 corners. Nothing in the news points either way, so I stay with the number.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.9 cards. Sporting have the most yellow cards of the two by a distance (37 to Eibar's 24), and with play-off places at stake I lean slightly higher.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.8 shots. Both sides have taken almost the same number of shots this season (121 and 122), and I see no reason to move away from the figure.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.2 shots on target. Iván Gil and Gorka Guruzeta lead Eibar's scoring and Sporting's goals are spread thin, so I stay with the number.
